description: WeddingCull photographic dataset registry. Contains no copyrighted image data and no machine-specific absolute paths.

license_gate_policy.commercial_weight_promotion_rule: No model weights trained on datasets with commercial_training_allowed=false may be incorporated into shipping commercial release builds.

datasets.name: Photo Triage
datasets.citation: Huiwen Chang, Fisher Yu, Jue Wang, Douglas Ashley, Adam Finkelstein. Automatic Triage for a Photo Series. ACM Transactions on Graphics (Proc. SIGGRAPH) 35(4), 2016.
datasets.notes: Princeton Adobe Photo Triage benchmark. Primary dataset for same-moment photo ranking, burst selection, and human pairwise preferences.

datasets.name: PARA
datasets.citation: Yuzhe Yang, Liwu Xu, Leida Li, Nan Qie, Yaqian Li, Peng Zhang, Yandong Guo. Personalized Image Aesthetics Assessment with Rich Attributes. CVPR 2022.
datasets.notes: Personalized Image Aesthetics Assessment dataset by OPPO Research Institute. Governed by OPPO Public Data Service Agreement (strictly non-commercial research and learning).

datasets.name: HRIQ
datasets.citation: Huang Huang, Qiang Wan, Jari Korhonen. High Resolution Image Quality Database. IEEE ICASSP 2024.
datasets.notes: High Resolution Image Quality database. The 2880x2160 version is the canonical subjective MOS resolution. Lower resolutions (1024x768, 512x384) are used for downsampling and preview robustness studies.

datasets.name: CUHK Blur
datasets.citation: Jianping Shi, Li Xu, Jiaya Jia. Discriminative Blur Detection Features. CVPR 2014.
datasets.notes: CUHK Blur detection dataset. Used to validate subject-in-focus vs. intentional bokeh background differentiation. High blurred percentage does not imply rejection for portraits with shallow depth-of-field.

datasets.name: CEW
datasets.citation: Fengyi Song, Xiaoyang Tan, Xuezhi Liu, Songcan Chen. Eyes Closeness Detection from Still Images with Multi-scale Histograms of Principal Oriented Gradients. ICPR 2014.
datasets.notes: Closed Eyes in the Wild (CEW) dataset. Primary safety metric is false CLOSED rate to prevent false rejection of open-eyed portraits.

datasets.name: MRL Eye
datasets.citation: Media Research Lab, VSB - Technical University of Ostrava, 2018.
datasets.notes: Large-scale eye-state dataset with 84,937 crops across 37 subjects. Used for evaluating eye-state classification under reflections, bad lighting, and glasses.

datasets.name: AlbumBench / CUFED
datasets.citation: Yufei Wang, Zhe Lin, Jimei Yang, Jianming Zhang, Xiaoou Tang. A Curated Dataset of Album Selection. CVPR 2018.
datasets.notes: Curated Album Selection benchmark. Evaluates album-level narrative diversity and coverage rather than per-burst frame ranking.
